The structure of Mn3Cu4Ge8 (Mn3Cu4Ge8) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 15 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu and Mn centers each coordinated by 10 neighbors, while Ge adopts a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement with 8 geometric neighbors; the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Ge 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing between Cu 10-vertex polyhedra.
